description: LiveCodeBench (execution subset) expert-routing traces, one MoE layer, decode tokens only. One row = the top-k expert ids of one token. Rows are in prompt order, then token order.

eval.use: tokens the benchmark samples its batches from

pool.use: load histogram the placement is planned from (the preceding window)

pool_sha_note: sha256 fingerprint of the full per-prompt trace set the slices were extracted from; it seeds the batch sampler so that benchmark batches are reproducible bit-for-bit.
